items.title: 凱基期貨拓全球商品版圖 「股農金能」四板塊微型合約齊發
items.title_en: KGI Futures Expands Global Commodity Portfolio, Launches Micro Contracts Across Four Sectors
paras: 凱基證券今 (11) 日指出，面對美國大選變數、全球氣候異常和各國貨幣政策變動，單一投資市場的波動風險正悄升溫，為協助投資人打造抗震又靈活的全天候資產防護網，凱基期貨積極擴充全球商品線，陸續上架涵蓋指數、農產品、貴金屬與能源四大板塊的期貨新合約。
凱基期貨表示，將持續引進多元且低門檻的微型商品，其中，已率先於 6 月 30 日上架韓國交易所夜盤商品，包含小型 KOSPI 200(MKS2)、KOSPI 200(KS)、KOSDAQ 150(KSQ)、三年韓國債券 (KTB)、十年韓國債券 (LKTB) 和美元兌韓圜期貨 (USD)，提供投資人跨時區交易選擇。
而凱基期貨四大板塊新合約陸續登場，包括 7 月 31 日上架的 EUREX 交易所「MSCI 世界指數 (FMWO)」、將於 8 月 21 日推出 SGX 交易所的「微型日經 225 指數 (NS)」。

除了股市相關商品，極端氣候和通膨議題也是下半年的市場關注焦點。凱基期貨於 8 月 14 日上架 CME Group 的微型玉米 (MZC)、微型黃豆 (MZS)、春麥 (HRS) 和小型白銀 (QI) 等商品。透過微型化的農產品合約，讓投資人可將氣候異常這類宏觀議題轉化為實際的交易策略，靈活對沖日常餐桌上的通膨成本；而兼具工業與避險雙重屬性的小型白銀，可進一步強化投資組合的抗震力；同日上架的還有 EUREX 交易所的製氣油 (G)，將滿足機構法人與高階交易客群對於歐洲能源轉型與冬季能源儲備的專業避險需求。
paras_en: KGI Securities said on the 11th that amid the uncertainties of the U.S. election, abnormal global climate patterns and shifting monetary policies worldwide, the volatility risk of single‑market investing is quietly heating up. To help investors build a resilient yet flexible all‑weather asset protection net, KGI Futures is actively expanding its global commodity line, gradually adding new futures contracts covering four major sectors: indices, agricultural products, precious metals and energy.

KGI Futures said it will continue to introduce diverse, low‑threshold micro‑commodities. It has already launched night‑session products on the Korea Exchange as of June 30, including the mini KOSPI 200 (MKS2), KOSPI 200 (KS), KOSDAQ 150 (KSQ), 3‑year Korean Treasury Bond (KTB), 10‑year Korean Treasury Bond (LKTB) and USD/KRW futures (USD), giving investors cross‑time‑zone trading options.

The four‑sector new contracts will roll out sequentially, with the EUREX‑listed MSCI World Index (FMWO) debuting on July 31 and the SGX‑listed micro Nikkei 225 Index (NS) slated for launch on August 21.

Beyond equity‑related products, extreme weather and inflation remain key market themes for the second half of the year. On August 14, KGI Futures added CME Group’s micro corn (MZC), micro soybeans (MZS), spring wheat (HRS) and mini silver (QI) contracts. These micro agricultural contracts let investors turn macro issues like climate anomalies into concrete trading strategies to flexibly hedge everyday food‑price inflation, while the mini silver contract, with both industrial and safe‑haven attributes, can further bolster portfolio resilience. The same day, EUREX’s gasoil (G) was listed to meet institutional and advanced traders’ professional hedging needs for Europe’s energy transition and winter energy reserves.

items.title: 澳洲利率連兩度凍漲在4.35% 政策方向與Fed更趨於一致
items.title_en: Australia Holds Interest Rate at 4.35% for Second Straight Time
paras: 澳洲央行 (RBA) 周二 (11 日) 決議維持現金利率在 4.35% 不變，連續第二次會議按兵不動，以觀察失業率攀升和房市轉弱對經濟活動的抑制效果，是否足以讓通膨降溫。澳幣聞訊走軟，貶 0.1%。
澳洲央行今年稍早曾連三度升息，累計調升 75 個基點 (3 碼)，抵銷去年降息 75 個基點的全部幅度。8 月的決議獲得全數委員支持，也符合市場普遍預期。
澳洲公布 6 月為止一季的通膨數據低於市場預期之後，強化了 RBA 暫停升息的理由。澳洲央行在聲明中說：「委員會仍聚焦在確保高通膨不會成為長期趨勢。在判定貨幣政策仍具有一定程度限制性的情況下，委員會將「持續採取認為有必要的行動，以使通膨持續回到目標水準，包括在上行風險顯現時進一步調升現金利率目標。」
對澳洲而言，經濟情勢中最大的不確定因素在於美伊戰爭談判仍僵持不下。
Connective 執行董事 Mark Haron 表示，這次維持利率不變將為房貸借款人帶來一些喘息空間，但即使利率暫停上調，家庭面臨的潛在壓力仍相當大。
Connective 旗下的房貸經紀網絡觀察到，借款人正逐漸接受利率可能維持高檔一段時間的現實，這種不確定性持續打擊信心，消費者信心處於過去 50 年來最低迷的水準之一，這種謹慎態度也蔓延至整體房市活動：許多買家花更多時間做出決定，部分賣家則選擇暫緩掛牌，等待市場環境改善。
澳洲這波房價下跌由市場晴雨表雪梨領跌，當地房價已從高點回擋 5.3%，但住宅價格中位數仍高達 124 萬澳元 (約 87 萬美元)，凸顯先前的漲勢有多強勁。
澳洲本次按兵不動，使其政策立場與美國聯準會 (Fed) 更趨於一致。Fed 上月底連續第五次維持利率不變，不過有三名與會者投下反對票、主張升息 1 碼(0.25 個百分點)。
paras_en: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) decided to keep the cash rate at 4.35% on Tuesday (11th), marking the second consecutive meeting without a rate hike. The decision was made to observe the impact of rising unemployment and a weakening housing market on economic activity, and whether it would be enough to cool down inflation. The Australian dollar softened after the news, falling 0.1%.

The RBA had raised interest rates three times earlier this year, totaling 75 basis points (3/4%), offsetting the entire 75 basis point cut made last year. The August decision was unanimous and in line with market expectations.

The RBA's decision was reinforced by the release of June quarter inflation data, which came in below market expectations. In a statement, the RBA said: "The committee remains focused on ensuring that high inflation does not become a long-term trend. In a situation where monetary policy is still considered to have some degree of restriction, the committee will continue to take actions deemed necessary to ensure inflation returns to target, including further increasing the cash rate target in the event of rising risks."
For Australia, the biggest uncertainty in the economic situation is the ongoing stalemate in US-Iran war negotiations.

Mark Haron, executive director of Connective, said that maintaining the interest rate would provide some breathing space for home loan borrowers, but even with no further rate hikes, households still face significant pressure.

Connective's housing loan brokerage network observed that borrowers are gradually accepting the reality that interest rates may remain high for a while, which continues to erode confidence. Consumer confidence is at one of the lowest levels in the past 50 years, and this cautious attitude has also spread to the overall housing market activity: many buyers are taking more time to make decisions, while some sellers are choosing to delay listing their properties, waiting for the market environment to improve.

The Sydney housing market, which has been leading the decline in house prices, has seen prices drop by 5.3% from their peak. However, the median house price remains at AU$1.24 million (approximately US$870,000), highlighting the strength of the previous price surge.

Australia's decision to hold rates steady has brought its policy stance closer to that of the US Federal Reserve (Fed). The Fed kept rates unchanged for the fifth consecutive time last month, with three members voting against the decision, advocating for a 0.25 percentage point rate hike.

items.title: 馬斯克挑戰ASML EUV獨霸地位？TeraFab傳擬改用FEL光源造晶片
paras: 特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克旗下傳出籌備中的晶圓廠計畫「TeraFab」，可能捨棄艾司摩爾 (ASML-US) 獨家壟斷的極紫外光（EUV）雷射誘發電漿（LPP）光源技術，改採自由電子雷射（FEL）路線產生曝光所需的短波長光源。
若消息屬實，這將是半導體先進製程數十年來最核心的光源技術首度出現挑戰者，牽動的不只是艾司摩爾的市場地位，更可能改寫晶圓代工業長期倚賴單一供應商的產業結構。
這項推測源自有分析人士觀察 TeraFab 公開的廠房設計後提出，馬斯克本人稍後的回應內容，並未否認這個方向，讓討論在業界迅速發酵。
不過截至目前，馬斯克與其團隊尚未正式證實相關規劃，一切仍屬外界解讀。
分析指出，外界之所以認真看待這個猜測，關鍵在於 FEL 在光源性能上確實展現出 LPP 難以企及的優勢。
現行艾司摩爾的 EUV 光源波長固定在 13.5 奈米，輸出功率長期卡在 1 千瓦左右的天花板；FEL 不僅波長可依電子束能量與磁場設定自由調整，功率更可輕易達到數千瓦甚至數萬瓦等級，同調性與光波純淨度也非 LPP 能比擬。
能源效率上差距同樣懸殊：LPP 系統約需 4.4 百萬瓦電力才能產出 1 千瓦可用 EUV 光，整體效率僅約 0.05%；採用能量回收技術的 FEL 系統（ERL-FEL）估計僅需 0.7 百萬瓦即可產出等量光源，效率高出約六倍。
事實上，走 FEL 路線並非馬斯克首創。美國新創公司、由英特爾前執行長季辛格（Pat Gelsinger）出任執行董事長的 xLight 早已投入此一領域。
xLight 的架構是將電子送入粒子加速器加速後，導入具週期性磁場的波盪器產生同調光束，再透過類似光纖管線的傳輸系統，將光源從中央加速器設備分送至晶圓廠內各台曝光機。
該公司宣稱其光源功率可達現行 LPP 的四倍，單一系統最多可供應二十台艾司摩爾曝光機，使用年限長達三十年，有望大幅壓低晶圓廠的資本與營運支出。
值得注意的是，儘管光源性能佔優，FEL 要真正取代現行 EUV 量產工藝，仍有相當長的路要走。
分析指出，EUV 微影對光源的要求不只是「產生特定波長的光」，還必須同時具備高穩定性、高重複頻率、高可靠度、極低成本與極長運轉時間，並與現行反射式光學系統相容，這正是艾司摩爾歷經多年工程化累積出的護城河。
相較之下，FEL 需搭配大型電子加速器、波盪器、真空系統與束流控制系統等龐大設備，體積與建置成本都相當可觀，短期內難以複製艾司摩爾的量產優勢。
業界人士分析，FEL 真正的價值或許不在於立即取代現行 EUV，而在於為下一世代更短波長的微影技術鋪路。
一旦製程進入 6 奈米級、5 奈米級甚至更短波長的探索階段，FEL 波長可調、高同調性、高峰值亮度的特性將更具吸引力，但波長愈短，連帶的光學系統、光罩、光阻材料與真空系統等挑戰也會同步升高。
除 FEL 外，高次諧波產生（HHG）、放電電漿（DPP）與同步輻射等技術路線也在業界討論之列，各自在成熟度、亮度與體積上各有取捨。
無論最終何者勝出，包括 FEL 在內的所有候選技術目前都仍面臨不少工程挑戰，距離商業化量產的時間表仍是未知數。
馬斯克旗下 TeraFab 究竟會採取何種光源路線，仍待官方進一步證實。

items.title: 美超微Q4財報將揭曉 毛利率看增至17% AI基建熱能否延續？
items.title_en: Supermicro to Report Q4 Earnings, Sees Gross Margin Hitting 17%
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，美超微 (Supermicro)(SMCI-US) 將在周二 (11 日) 美股盤後公布 2026 會計年度第四季財報。就在上月底，公司公布初步財務更新後，股價一度大漲超過 20%。
根據美超微提交文件，公司預期毛利率將介於 15% 至 17%，遠高於先前預估的 8.2% 至 8.4%。公司同時表示，第四季新增訂單金額超過 600 億美元。
今年 6 月，執行長梁見後曾在 X 平台上表示，公司計劃在一年內與 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 及 xAI 共同建造 GW 級資料中心。
根據彭博分析師共識預估，美超微第四季調整後每股盈餘 (EPS) 預計為 1.33 美元，營收則為 112 億美元。相比之下，去年同期 EPS 為 0.41 美元，營收為 57 億美元。
市場預期美超微第四季毛利率最高可達 15.8%，較去年同期增加 9.6%。
儘管初步財務更新帶動股價大幅上漲，美超微過去一年的股價表現仍落後其他 AI 基礎建設業者。
美超微股價過去 12 個月下跌約 30%，相比之下，慧與科技 (HPE-US) 同期上漲約 160%，戴爾 (DELL-US) 更大漲超過 230%。
今年 6 月，美超微宣布將籌集最高 70 億美元的股票掛鉤融資，以協助支付 AI 基礎建設擴張所需資金。
美超微近期也面臨監管方面的問題。今年 4 月，在美國司法部起訴共同創辦人廖益賢及另外兩人涉嫌違反美國出口管制規定後，公司啟動獨立調查。美超微並未被列為該案被告。
paras_en: Supermicro (SMCI-US) will report its fourth-quarter earnings on Tuesday, following the market close, according to a Yahoo Finance report. The stock price surged over 20% after the company released preliminary financial updates last month.

According to a filing by Supermicro, the company expects a gross margin of 15% to 17%, significantly higher than the previous estimate of 8.2% to 8.4%. The company also reported that new orders in the fourth quarter exceeded $6 billion.
In June, CEO Charles Liang mentioned on X that the company plans to build a GW-level data center with SpaceX (SPCX-US) and xAI within a year.

According to consensus estimates from Bloomberg analysts, Supermicro's fourth-quarter adjusted earnings per share (EPS) is expected to be $1.33, with revenue of $11.2 billion. This compares to $0.41 EPS and $5.7 billion revenue in the same period last year.
The market expects Supermicro's fourth-quarter gross margin to reach as high as 15.8%, a 9.6% increase from the same period last year.
Although the preliminary financial updates drove a significant surge in stock price, Supermicro's stock performance over the past year still lags behind other AI infrastructure companies.
Supermicro's stock price has fallen around 30% over the past 12 months, compared to a 160% increase for HPE (HPE-US) and a 230% surge for Dell (DELL-US) over the same period.
In June, Supermicro announced plans to raise up to $7 billion in stock-linked financing to help fund its AI infrastructure expansion.

Supermicro has also faced regulatory issues recently. In April, the US Department of Justice charged co-founder Ye Li and two others with violating US export control regulations. Supermicro launched an independent investigation but was not named as a defendant in the case.

items.title: 反駁降評傳言！外媒爆料蘋果2027年iPhone 20周年大改款仍在 採全玻璃設計
items.title_en: Denying Downgrade Rumors! Apple's 2027 iPhone 20th Anniversary Model Still Planned with All-Glass Design
paras: 知情人士透露，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 仍計劃在 iPhone 問世 20 周年之際，推出以玻璃為核心的全新外觀設計，反駁 Jefferies 分析師報告所稱相關計畫已遭取消的說法。
彭博科技記者 Mark Gurman 引述知情人士說法報導，蘋果仍預定明年推出採用全新玻璃質感外觀的 iPhone Pro 系列。這兩款內部代號為 V73 及 V74 的 iPhone，正面與背面均採用玻璃材質，玻璃將向機身兩側延伸，中間則以金屬框帶連接。
蘋果設計工作室曾主導一款更具前瞻性的版本，採用更多玻璃材質取代金屬，不過還在初期階段就被取消。知情人士表示，蘋果在連接不同玻璃面板時遇到問題，而且在進一步評估大規模量產時，發現這套設計難以維持。
自 2007 年 iPhone 問世以來，蘋果便持續探索更具突破性的設計，雖然打造「無縫玻璃」iPhone 的構想一直面臨技術挑戰，蘋果仍預期明年推出原始構想的進化版，為市場帶來驚喜。
Jefferies 分析師 Edison Lee 本周稍早引述供應鏈調查指出，全玻璃 iPhone 已遭取消，代表蘋果推出更高價位智慧手機的努力受挫，並以此為由，調降蘋果股票的投資建議評等。這導致蘋果周一終場收黑 1.5%。
但彭博訪問的其中一名知情人士表示，蘋果的產品路線圖並未改變。
iPhone 是蘋果最大營收來源，約占公司營收一半，而且最新一季財報顯示，iPhone 上季銷售成長 22%，仍優於其他業務。
新款 iPhone 的設計通常會在產品每年秋季發表前約一年定案，這代表 2027 年 iPhone 的設計目前已進入後期測試階段，除非遇到不在預期中的問題。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: A source close to the matter revealed that Apple (AAPL-US) is still planning to release a new iPhone design with a glass core to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone's release, contradicting a report from Jefferies analyst that the plan has been canceled.

According to a report by Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple is still planning to release a new iPhone Pro series with a new glass texture design next year. The two internal codenamed V73 and V74 iPhones will feature glass materials on both the front and back, with the glass extending to the sides and connected by a metal frame in the middle.

Apple's design studio had previously led a more forward-thinking version of the iPhone with more glass materials replacing metal, but it was canceled in its early stages. The source said that Apple encountered problems connecting different glass panels and found it difficult to maintain the design after further evaluation for mass production.

Since the iPhone's release in 2007, Apple has been continuously exploring more innovative designs. Although the concept of a 'seamless glass' iPhone has faced technical challenges, Apple still expects to release an evolved version of the original concept next year, surprising the market.

Jefferies analyst Edison Lee cited a supply chain investigation earlier this week, stating that the all-glass iPhone has been canceled, representing Apple's efforts to release a high-end smartphone at a higher price point have been thwarted, and as a result, downgraded Apple's stock investment recommendation rating. This led to Apple's stock closing down 1.5% on Monday.
However, a source close to Apple said that the company's product roadmap has not changed.

The iPhone is Apple's largest revenue source, accounting for about half of the company's revenue, and the latest quarterly report showed that iPhone sales grew 22% in the previous quarter, still outperforming other businesses.

The design of new iPhones is usually finalized about a year before their annual autumn release, which means that the 2027 iPhone design is currently in the late testing stage, unless any unexpected issues arise.
This article is not available for partnership reprint.

items.title: 德麥投資16億元建新廠辦今上樑 擴大4倍新產能擬2028年Q2投產
items.title_en: De Ma Investment of NT$16 Billion to Build New Factory and Logistics Center
paras: 上櫃烘焙原料廠德麥食品 (1264-TW) 成立以來最大單一投資擴充案啟動，德麥投資 16 億元興建新廠暨物流中心，預計 2028 年第二季正式投產，德麥新廠將導入乳製品加工及烘焙半成品產線，提升供應鏈效率與產能爲公司帶來成長動能。
德麥的此一 16 億元的大規模投資案並於今 (11) 日舉行「廠辦新建工程上樑典禮」，由董事長林雪嬌與總經理吳文欽親自主持，代表工程進入重要里程碑。德麥指出，新廠進入投產後的倉儲容量將由現有 1,000 個棧板儲位提升至 4,000 個, 規模擴增為 4 倍，可有效支撐未來營運成長需求。
德麥指出，隨著海內外烘焙市場與餐飲供應鏈需求持續攀升，高附加價值乳製品市場也穩定成長，德麥食品為因應客戶訂單增加與產業轉型需求，決議斥資打造新廠暨物流中心，結合完善的物流規劃與倉儲配置, 可有效縮短原料物流搬運與進出庫作業時間、大幅降低運輸與倉儲管理成本，並進一步提升供應鏈的韌性, 為全球與在地客戶提供更穩定、快速且高品質的供貨服務。
德麥董事長林雪嬌表示，此一新廠暨物流中心的興建，不僅是公司成立以來最大的投資案, 更是德麥落實永續經營、企業升級與中長期發展的重要布局。
同時，面對全球供應鏈重組及國內餐飲烘焙業人力短缺等趨勢，新廠將透過物流效能提升、生產能量擴充及供應鏈整合，進一步提升整體營運效率與服務能力，支持未來業務成長需求。新廠不只是增加空間, 更是公司長期發展的重要基礎建設。期待透過現代化硬體的建置, 為員工創造更安全高效的工作環境，也為股東與合作夥伴創造長期企業價值。
德麥食品表示，此次 16 億元投資並非單純擴建廠房, 而是著眼未來 5 - 10 年的營運布局。新廠預計 2028 年第 2 季正式投產，將成為公司未來營運成長的重要支柱, 透過高附加價值產品發展, 持續提升整體競爭力。
德麥新廠投產後，將聚焦台灣市場乳製品加工，並擴大自有製造及烘焙半成品等高附加價值產品布局。原總公司廠辦則規劃新增卡士達餡料等烘焙原料生產線。此外，因應大環境人口結構改變與產業缺工嚴重的市場趨勢，德麥食品也將積極擴展烘焙半成品的研發與量產規模, 協助下游客戶降低現場人力成本與技術門檻, 奠定產業長期競爭優勢。
paras_en: De Ma Food (1264-TW) has launched its largest single investment expansion project since its establishment, with an investment of NT$16 billion to build a new factory and logistics center. The new factory is expected to be operational in the second quarter of 2028 and will introduce dairy product processing and baking semi-finished product lines, improving supply chain efficiency and increasing production capacity to drive company growth.

De Ma's NT$16 billion large-scale investment project held a 'Topping-out Ceremony' today (11th), with Chairman Lin Xuejiao and General Manager Wu Wenqin personally hosting, marking the entry of the project into a critical milestone. De Ma pointed out that the new factory will increase storage capacity from the current 1,000 pallet storage spaces to 4,000, with a four-fold increase in scale, effectively supporting future operational growth needs.

De Ma pointed out that with the continuous rise of the global and domestic baking market and catering supply chain demand, the high-value-added dairy product market has also stabilized and grown. De Ma Food has decided to invest in building a new factory and logistics center to meet the increasing customer orders and industry transformation needs, combining perfect logistics planning and storage configuration to effectively shorten the transportation and storage of raw materials and reduce transportation and storage management costs.

De Ma Chairman Lin Xuejiao stated that the construction of this new factory and logistics center is not only the company's largest investment project since its establishment, but also an important layout for De Ma's sustainable operation, enterprise upgrading, and long-term development.

At the same time, facing the global supply chain reorganization and domestic baking industry labor shortages, the new factory will further improve logistics efficiency, production capacity, and supply chain integration through logistics efficiency improvement, production energy expansion, and supply chain integration, further improving overall operational efficiency and service capabilities to support future business growth needs.

De Ma Food stated that this NT$16 billion investment is not just a simple expansion of the factory, but a long-term operational layout for the next 5-10 years. The new factory is expected to be operational in the second quarter of 2028 and will become an important pillar for the company's future operational growth, through the development of high-value-added products to continuously improve overall competitiveness.

After the new factory is operational, it will focus on Taiwan's dairy product processing and expand its own manufacturing and baking semi-finished products, while the original headquarters factory will add a cassava filling production line for baking raw materials. In addition, De Ma Food will actively expand the research and production scale of baking semi-finished products to assist downstream customers in reducing on-site labor costs and technical barriers, laying a foundation for long-term industry competitiveness.

items.title: 仁寶桃園大溪AI伺服器製造中心啟用 第四季起逐步貢獻營收
items.title_en: RICOH's Taoyuan Daxi AI Server Manufacturing Center Officially Opens, Expected to Contribute to Revenue from Fourth Quarter
paras: 仁寶 (2324-TW) 今 (11) 日舉辦大溪 AI 伺服器製造中心剪綵啟用典禮，仁寶指出，大溪廠將投入 AI 伺服器系統 (L10) 及機櫃 (L11) 製造，預計第四季起逐步貢獻營收，屆時 AI 伺服器系統產能將倍增，並新增機櫃製造能力。
仁寶積極布局 AI 伺服器業務，今年 5 月宣布投資大溪廠，涵蓋不動產購置、廠房改建與先進製造設備導入，總投資金額達 40.3 億元，土地面積約 7654 平方公尺，建物面積約 21706 平方公尺。
仁寶指出，大溪廠除投入 AI 伺服器 L10 及 L11 製造，也將導入自主研發的液冷散熱技術，並聚焦 Rack-level 系統整合、先進冷卻技術與高密度 AI 基礎與高密度 AI 基礎設施製造能力，以因應 AI 伺服器高功耗、高密度運算及高可靠性的需求，提供更穩定且具備優異能源效率的整體解決方案。
董事長陳瑞聰指出，仁寶客戶版圖已從傳統 PC ODM 客戶，擴展至 NeoCloud 市場，為仁寶今年伺服器業務主要成長動能，下一階段將進一步拓展至 Hyperscaler 及 Enterprise 企業客戶市場。
陳瑞聰說，2 年前仁寶在 AI 伺服器領域中仍屬門外漢，但經過幾年的投入，仁寶已成功轉型，在 AI 伺服器領域已有斬獲，目標在今年底前進入業界中段班，並持續往前段班邁進。
整體而言，陳瑞聰表示，美國德州 2 座廠預計於年底初步量產，待明年全面開出產能，加上台灣與越南製造基地，對於 2027 年的 AI 伺服器業務成長具信心。
paras_en: RICOH (2324-TW) held a ribbon-cutting ceremony for its Daxi AI server manufacturing center today (11th). RICOH stated that the Daxi factory will invest in AI server systems (L10) and cabinets (L11) production, and is expected to contribute to revenue from the fourth quarter. At that time, AI server system capacity will double, and cabinet manufacturing capacity will be added.

RICOH has been actively laying out its AI server business. In May this year, it announced an investment in the Daxi factory, covering land acquisition, factory renovation, and the introduction of advanced manufacturing equipment, with a total investment of NT$40.3 billion, a land area of approximately 7,654 square meters, and a building area of approximately 21,706 square meters.

RICOH pointed out that the Daxi factory, in addition to investing in AI server L10 and L11 production, will also introduce self-developed liquid cooling heat dissipation technology, and focus on rack-level system integration, advanced cooling technology, and high-density AI foundation and high-density AI infrastructure manufacturing capabilities, to meet the demands of high-power, high-density computing, and high-reliability AI servers, and provide more stable and energy-efficient overall solutions.

Chairman Chen Ruicong pointed out that RICOH's customer map has expanded from traditional PC ODM customers to NeoCloud, which is the main growth driver for RICOH's server business this year. The next stage will further expand to Hyperscaler and Enterprise corporate customer markets.

Chen Ruicong said that two years ago, RICOH was still a newcomer in the AI server field, but after several years of investment, RICOH has successfully transformed and achieved results in the AI server field. The goal is to enter the middle class of the industry by the end of this year and continue to move forward to the front class.

In general, Chen Ruicong expressed confidence in RICOH's AI server business growth in 2027, with the two factories in Texas, USA, expected to start production in early December, and Taiwan and Vietnam manufacturing bases, and the company is confident in its AI server business growth in 2027.

items.title: 《大賣空》貝瑞開轟網路泡沫富豪！庫班自嘲接招  兩大投資人再槓AI泡沫
items.title_en: Burry Blasts Web Bubble Billionaires, Cuban Jokes Back
paras: 電影《大賣空》原型、知名投資人貝瑞（Michael Burry），近日在社群平台 X 上重炮批評當年網路泡沫時期崛起的富豪，意外引來億萬富翁庫班（Mark Cuban）幽默回應，兩人一來一往的交鋒在投資圈掀起話題。
根據《Business Insider》報導，貝瑞近日發文指出，1998 年長期資本管理公司（LTCM）倒閉，到 2000 年 3 月網路泡沫破裂之間，股價早已脫離基本面。
他說：「一群十足的蠢蛋在那段期間賺進了永久的財富」。貝瑞更補上一句：「其中一人現在還經常在我們耳邊出現。」
雖然貝瑞沒有點名，但身為網路泡沫時期崛起的代表性富豪之一，庫班顯然似乎很樂意配合。
他回覆「十足的蠢蛋」，還附上一個笑到流淚的表情符號，同時附上自己 2025 年發布的一則舊文。內容列出他所創辦的網路廣播公司 Broadcast.com，在被雅虎（Yahoo）收購前，律師團隊曾考慮申請的 13 項專利構想。
庫班在 1999 年將 Broadcast.com 以 57 億美元的股票交易出售給雅虎，一戰成名，成為網路泡沫時代最具代表性的贏家之一。
根據他當年列出的專利構想，內容涵蓋網路連線裝置的地理定位、混合網路架構、反向拍賣機制、音訊廣告、串流身分驗證，以及自動化內容推薦等技術。
事實上，貝瑞近幾個月來不斷公開示警，認為市場投資人正忽視資產估值過高的風險，一味追捧人工智慧（AI）熱潮，未來恐將付出代價。
此前，貝瑞才在 X 上拋出提問：「我是不是最後一個看空的人？」
對此，庫班同樣以他的招牌名言回應：「在牛市裡，人人都是天才。」暗示資產價格狂飆時，幾乎所有投資人都會顯得眼光獨到。
值得注意的是，這波交鋒發生在兩人先後對 AI 基礎建設熱潮表達疑慮之後。
貝瑞多次警告，科技巨頭在晶片與資料中心上的投資規模過於龐大，恐怕很快就會因技術更迭而遭到淘汰。
庫班則持類似看法，認為效率提升可能使部分 AI 基礎設施淪為過剩產能，他甚至打趣說，未來許多資料中心恐怕會被改建成匹克球球場。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the inspiration behind the film 'The Big Short', recently fired off a scathing critique of web bubble billionaires on social media platform X, prompting billionaire Mark Cuban to respond with humor, sparking a heated exchange in the investment community.

According to Business Insider, Burry recently posted that between the collapse of Long-Term Capital Management (LTCM) in 1998 and the bursting of the web bubble in March 2000, stock prices had already diverged from their fundamental value.
He said, 'A bunch of complete idiots made permanent wealth during that period.' Burry added, 'One of them is still constantly in our ears.'
Although Burry didn't name names, as a representative of the web bubble era's rising billionaires, Cuban seemed to be playing along.

He replied, 'Complete idiots,' accompanied by a laughing emoji, and attached an old post from 2025, listing 13 patent ideas his lawyer team considered filing for his web broadcasting company Broadcast.com before it was acquired by Yahoo.
Cuban sold Broadcast.com to Yahoo for $5.7 billion in stock in 1999, cementing his status as one of the web bubble era's most iconic winners.

According to his 1999 list of patent ideas, the concepts included geolocation for network devices, hybrid network architecture, reverse auction mechanisms, audio ads, streaming identity verification, and automated content recommendation.
In fact, Burry has been warning publicly for months that investors are ignoring the risk of overvalued assets and chasing the AI hype, potentially facing a reckoning.
Earlier, Burry asked on X, 'Am I the last one to be bearish?'
Cuban responded with his signature phrase, 'In a bull market, everyone is a genius,' implying that asset prices skyrocketing make almost every investor seem brilliant.
Notably, this exchange occurred after both men expressed concerns about the AI infrastructure hype.
Burry has repeatedly warned that tech giants' massive investments in chips and data centers will be obsolete soon due to technological advancements.
Cuban shares a similar view, believing that efficiency gains may render some AI infrastructure redundant, even joking that many data centers might be repurposed as pickleball courts in the future.

items.title: 凱基期貨拓全球商品版圖 「股農金能」四板塊微型合約齊發
items.title_en: KGI Futures Expands Global Commodity Portfolio, Launches Micro Contracts Across Four Sectors
paras: 凱基證券今 (11) 日指出，面對美國大選變數、全球氣候異常和各國貨幣政策變動，單一投資市場的波動風險正悄升溫，為協助投資人打造抗震又靈活的全天候資產防護網，凱基期貨積極擴充全球商品線，陸續上架涵蓋指數、農產品、貴金屬與能源四大板塊的期貨新合約。
凱基期貨表示，將持續引進多元且低門檻的微型商品，其中，已率先於 6 月 30 日上架韓國交易所夜盤商品，包含小型 KOSPI 200(MKS2)、KOSPI 200(KS)、KOSDAQ 150(KSQ)、三年韓國債券 (KTB)、十年韓國債券 (LKTB) 和美元兌韓圜期貨 (USD)，提供投資人跨時區交易選擇。
而凱基期貨四大板塊新合約陸續登場，包括 7 月 31 日上架的 EUREX 交易所「MSCI 世界指數 (FMWO)」、將於 8 月 21 日推出 SGX 交易所的「微型日經 225 指數 (NS)」。

除了股市相關商品，極端氣候和通膨議題也是下半年的市場關注焦點。凱基期貨於 8 月 14 日上架 CME Group 的微型玉米 (MZC)、微型黃豆 (MZS)、春麥 (HRS) 和小型白銀 (QI) 等商品。透過微型化的農產品合約，讓投資人可將氣候異常這類宏觀議題轉化為實際的交易策略，靈活對沖日常餐桌上的通膨成本；而兼具工業與避險雙重屬性的小型白銀，可進一步強化投資組合的抗震力；同日上架的還有 EUREX 交易所的製氣油 (G)，將滿足機構法人與高階交易客群對於歐洲能源轉型與冬季能源儲備的專業避險需求。
paras_en: KGI Securities said on the 11th that amid the uncertainties of the U.S. election, abnormal global climate patterns and shifting monetary policies worldwide, the volatility risk of single‑market investing is quietly heating up. To help investors build a resilient yet flexible all‑weather asset protection net, KGI Futures is actively expanding its global commodity line, gradually adding new futures contracts covering four major sectors: indices, agricultural products, precious metals and energy.

KGI Futures said it will continue to introduce diverse, low‑threshold micro‑commodities. It has already launched night‑session products on the Korea Exchange as of June 30, including the mini KOSPI 200 (MKS2), KOSPI 200 (KS), KOSDAQ 150 (KSQ), 3‑year Korean Treasury Bond (KTB), 10‑year Korean Treasury Bond (LKTB) and USD/KRW futures (USD), giving investors cross‑time‑zone trading options.

The four‑sector new contracts will roll out sequentially, with the EUREX‑listed MSCI World Index (FMWO) debuting on July 31 and the SGX‑listed micro Nikkei 225 Index (NS) slated for launch on August 21.

Beyond equity‑related products, extreme weather and inflation remain key market themes for the second half of the year. On August 14, KGI Futures added CME Group’s micro corn (MZC), micro soybeans (MZS), spring wheat (HRS) and mini silver (QI) contracts. These micro agricultural contracts let investors turn macro issues like climate anomalies into concrete trading strategies to flexibly hedge everyday food‑price inflation, while the mini silver contract, with both industrial and safe‑haven attributes, can further bolster portfolio resilience. The same day, EUREX’s gasoil (G) was listed to meet institutional and advanced traders’ professional hedging needs for Europe’s energy transition and winter energy reserves.

De Ma Chairman Lin Xuejiao stated that the construction of this new factory and logistics center is not only the company's largest investment project since its establishment, but also an important layout for De Ma's sustainable operation, enterprise upgrading, and long-term development.

At the same time, facing the global supply chain reorganization and domestic baking industry labor shortages, the new factory will further improve logistics efficiency, production capacity, and supply chain integration through logistics efficiency improvement, production energy expansion, and supply chain integration, further improving overall operational efficiency and service capabilities to support future business growth needs.

De Ma Food stated that this NT$16 billion investment is not just a simple expansion of the factory, but a long-term operational layout for the next 5-10 years. The new factory is expected to be operational in the second quarter of 2028 and will become an important pillar for the company's future operational growth, through the development of high-value-added products to continuously improve overall competitiveness.

After the new factory is operational, it will focus on Taiwan's dairy product processing and expand its own manufacturing and baking semi-finished products, while the original headquarters factory will add a cassava filling production line for baking raw materials. In addition, De Ma Food will actively expand the research and production scale of baking semi-finished products to assist downstream customers in reducing on-site labor costs and technical barriers, laying a foundation for long-term industry competitiveness.

items.title: 仁寶桃園大溪AI伺服器製造中心啟用 第四季起逐步貢獻營收
items.title_en: RICOH's Taoyuan Daxi AI Server Manufacturing Center Officially Opens, Expected to Contribute to Revenue from Fourth Quarter
paras: 仁寶 (2324-TW) 今 (11) 日舉辦大溪 AI 伺服器製造中心剪綵啟用典禮，仁寶指出，大溪廠將投入 AI 伺服器系統 (L10) 及機櫃 (L11) 製造，預計第四季起逐步貢獻營收，屆時 AI 伺服器系統產能將倍增，並新增機櫃製造能力。
仁寶積極布局 AI 伺服器業務，今年 5 月宣布投資大溪廠，涵蓋不動產購置、廠房改建與先進製造設備導入，總投資金額達 40.3 億元，土地面積約 7654 平方公尺，建物面積約 21706 平方公尺。
仁寶指出，大溪廠除投入 AI 伺服器 L10 及 L11 製造，也將導入自主研發的液冷散熱技術，並聚焦 Rack-level 系統整合、先進冷卻技術與高密度 AI 基礎與高密度 AI 基礎設施製造能力，以因應 AI 伺服器高功耗、高密度運算及高可靠性的需求，提供更穩定且具備優異能源效率的整體解決方案。
董事長陳瑞聰指出，仁寶客戶版圖已從傳統 PC ODM 客戶，擴展至 NeoCloud 市場，為仁寶今年伺服器業務主要成長動能，下一階段將進一步拓展至 Hyperscaler 及 Enterprise 企業客戶市場。
陳瑞聰說，2 年前仁寶在 AI 伺服器領域中仍屬門外漢，但經過幾年的投入，仁寶已成功轉型，在 AI 伺服器領域已有斬獲，目標在今年底前進入業界中段班，並持續往前段班邁進。
整體而言，陳瑞聰表示，美國德州 2 座廠預計於年底初步量產，待明年全面開出產能，加上台灣與越南製造基地，對於 2027 年的 AI 伺服器業務成長具信心。
paras_en: RICOH (2324-TW) held a ribbon-cutting ceremony for its Daxi AI server manufacturing center today (11th). RICOH stated that the Daxi factory will invest in AI server systems (L10) and cabinets (L11) production, and is expected to contribute to revenue from the fourth quarter. At that time, AI server system capacity will double, and cabinet manufacturing capacity will be added.

RICOH has been actively laying out its AI server business. In May this year, it announced an investment in the Daxi factory, covering land acquisition, factory renovation, and the introduction of advanced manufacturing equipment, with a total investment of NT$40.3 billion, a land area of approximately 7,654 square meters, and a building area of approximately 21,706 square meters.

RICOH pointed out that the Daxi factory, in addition to investing in AI server L10 and L11 production, will also introduce self-developed liquid cooling heat dissipation technology, and focus on rack-level system integration, advanced cooling technology, and high-density AI foundation and high-density AI infrastructure manufacturing capabilities, to meet the demands of high-power, high-density computing, and high-reliability AI servers, and provide more stable and energy-efficient overall solutions.

Chairman Chen Ruicong pointed out that RICOH's customer map has expanded from traditional PC ODM customers to NeoCloud, which is the main growth driver for RICOH's server business this year. The next stage will further expand to Hyperscaler and Enterprise corporate customer markets.

Chen Ruicong said that two years ago, RICOH was still a newcomer in the AI server field, but after several years of investment, RICOH has successfully transformed and achieved results in the AI server field. The goal is to enter the middle class of the industry by the end of this year and continue to move forward to the front class.

In general, Chen Ruicong expressed confidence in RICOH's AI server business growth in 2027, with the two factories in Texas, USA, expected to start production in early December, and Taiwan and Vietnam manufacturing bases, and the company is confident in its AI server business growth in 2027.

items.title: 和泰車成立國瑞安衛家族 桃園近30個供應鏈夥伴加入
items.title_en: Hetai Motors Launches GuoRui Safety Family, Nearly 30 Taoyuan Supply-Chain Partners Join
paras: 和泰車 (2207-TW) 旗下國瑞汽車今 (11) 日宣布，為響應政府推動職業安全衛生政策，並善盡企業社會責任 (CSR)，正式成立「國瑞安衛家族」，邀集桃園地區 28 家供應鏈夥伴共同參與，透過大廠攜手小廠的合作模式，分享安全管理經驗與資源，共同提升產業安全衛生管理能量。
桃園市勞檢處處長王振鴻表示，國瑞汽車作為國內汽車產業的指標企業，長期以來在職業安全衛生的表現上堪稱業界標竿，近年更推動智慧化安衛管理與設備本質安全，做到「全員參與」的卓越績效。
王振鴻進一步說，本次國瑞願意無私站出來扮演「核心企業」，將國際級的管理經驗與資源分享給在地夥伴，展現了高度的企業社會責任，勞檢處對此表達高度肯定與謝忱。
國瑞總經理古屋敷指出，希望透過成立「國瑞安衛家族」，將多年累積的管理經驗、教育訓練及技術資源與供應鏈夥伴共享，共同打造更具韌性的產業生態。
未來國瑞安衛家族將持續辦理職業安全衛生研修會、教育訓練、觀摩交流及宣導活動，建立「事前預防」和「當事者意識」的安全文化。
paras_en: Hetai Motors (2207-TW) subsidiary GuoRui Automotive announced today (the 11th) that, to respond to the government’s occupational safety and health policy and fulfill corporate social responsibility (CSR), it formally established the “GuoRui Safety Family,” inviting 28 supply-chain partners in the Taoyuan area to participate. Through a large‑firm‑by‑small‑firm cooperation model, they will share safety‑management experience and resources, jointly enhancing the industry’s occupational safety and health capabilities.

Wang Zhenhong, director of the Taoyuan City Labor Inspection Office, said that GuoRui Automotive, as a benchmark company in the domestic automobile industry, has long been an industry standard in occupational safety and health performance, and in recent years has promoted smart safety management and inherent equipment safety, achieving “full‑staff participation” with outstanding results.

Wang added that this time GuoRui is willing to selflessly act as a “core enterprise,” sharing internationally‑level management experience and resources with local partners, demonstrating a high level of corporate social responsibility. The Labor Inspection Office expressed strong approval and gratitude.

GuoRui General Manager Gu Yashiki pointed out that through establishing the “GuoRui Safety Family,” the company hopes to share years of accumulated management experience, training and technical resources with supply-chain partners, jointly building a more resilient industry ecosystem.

In the future, the GuoRui Safety Family will continue to hold occupational safety and health workshops, training sessions, observation exchanges and outreach activities, establishing a safety culture of “pre‑emptive prevention” and “personal awareness.”

items.title: 7月營收連三月創新高，看好下半年營運持續升溫
items.title_en: Yixiang Enterprise Achieves Record-High Revenue for Third Consecutive Month, Expects Continued Growth in Second Half
paras: 全球先進製程微污染防治（AMC）濾網龍頭——鈺祥企業（股票代號：7909），今（10）日召開董事會並公布 2026 年上半年財務報告與 7 月份營收成果。受惠於全球晶圓代工龍頭客戶先進製程產能持續擴張，鈺祥上半年營運繳出亮眼成績單，歸屬母公司稅後淨利攀升至 1.36 億元，每股稅後盈餘（EPS）達 1.93 元，年增幅高達 370.7%。同時，7 月份合併營收達 3.05 億元，實現連續三個月締造單月歷史新高的佳績。
上半年獲利強勁翻倍，7 月營收續創單月歷史新高

在營運績效方面，鈺祥 2026 年上半年合併營收達 11.64 億元，較去年同期成長 53.1%。儘管面臨原物料價格波動挑戰，毛利率仍維持 36.3%；經營團隊透過精準的成本與費用控管，推升營業利益達 1.38 億元，年增 28.9%，帶動歸屬母公司稅後淨利爆發性成長至 1.36 億元，年增 377.8%，稅後每股盈餘達到新台幣 1.93 元，年增 370.7%。此外，受惠先進製程一次性濾網需求持續升溫，鈺祥 7 月份合併營收達 3.05 億元，月增 23.40%，年增 63.55%，實現連續三個月締造單月歷史新高的佳績。
「濾網摩爾定律」發酵，雙產品線接力挹注營收爆發

鈺祥經營團隊指出，半導體晶圓代工龍頭持續建置先進製程新廠區，在「濾網摩爾定律」帶動下，製程節點微縮使空氣潔淨度與微污染控制的精密度要求呈倍數成長。隨著新建廠區陸續進入裝機與預量產階段，前期所需的高階一次性濾網出貨持續暢旺。而當廠區營運滿一年內，客戶為達成永續減碳與零廢棄目標，將陸續導入再生型化學濾網。鈺祥具備一次性與再生型雙產品線的完整佈局，精準對接晶圓廠生命週期，成為推升營收與獲利成長的關鍵引擎。
先進封裝需求起飛，下半年「CaaS 訂閱制」轉換加速

展望 2026 年下半年，鈺祥經營層對營運前景維持高度樂觀。除了新建先進製程晶圓廠的穩健拉貨外，隨著大客戶先進封裝產能加速擴充，封裝端對微污染防治的要求已逐步向先進製程規格靠攏，進一步催化高階濾網的升級與替換需求。此外，公司首創之「潔淨空氣訂閱制（CaaS, Clean Air as a Service）」訂單將於下半年起加速轉換為實質營收，預期高毛利的再生型濾網單月貢獻將持續攀升。鈺祥憑藉在 5 奈米以下先進製程高達 80% 以上的絕對市佔率，將穩居「最純粹先進製程潔淨方案供應商」的龍頭地位，隨著營收規模持續擴大，亦將展現強勁的營運槓桿效益，為股東創造長遠的投資價值。

附表二：營收報告                                        (單位：新臺幣千元)
【關於鈺祥 (7909 TT)】

鈺祥 (7909 TT) 成立於 1987 年，鈺祥企業專注於氣態分子污染物（AMC）過濾技術的研發與製造，為全球先進製程微污染防治的領導品牌，於半導體先進製程高階濾網市佔率超過 80%。公司總部位於台灣新北市，並於台南設有先進製程濾網與再生濾網製造基地，服務據點遍及台灣、美國、中國大陸、歐洲及日本等全球半導體重鎮。已於多國取得超過 100 項專利，鈺祥致力於提供整合研發、製造、物流與安裝的「一站式 AMC 解決方案」，透過「再生型化學濾網」與「潔淨空氣訂閱制（CaaS）」，持續協助客戶精進半導體製造良率，目標成為 2nm 以下先進製程濾網的絕對領先者，引領半導體綠色濾網的新紀元。
paras_en: Yixiang Enterprise (stock code: 7909), a leading manufacturer of advanced process micro-pollution control (AMC) filters, held its board meeting and announced its 2026 first-half financial report and July revenue on July 10. Benefiting from the continuous expansion of advanced process capacity by leading semiconductor foundry customers, Yixiang's first-half operating performance was impressive, with net profit attributable to the parent company reaching NT$1.36 billion and earnings per share (EPS) reaching NT$1.93, a year-on-year growth of 370.7%. Meanwhile, the company's July combined revenue reached NT$3.05 billion, achieving a record high for the third consecutive month.

Yixiang's first-half net profit surged to NT$1.36 billion, with EPS reaching NT$1.93, a year-on-year growth of 370.7%. The company's July revenue also reached a record high for the third consecutive month.

In terms of operating performance, Yixiang's 2026 first-half combined revenue reached NT$11.64 billion, a year-on-year growth of 53.1%. Despite facing challenges from fluctuating raw material prices, the company's gross margin remained at 36.3%. Through precise cost and expense management, the company's operating income reached NT$1.38 billion, a year-on-year growth of 28.9%, driving net profit attributable to the parent company to NT$1.36 billion, a year-on-year growth of 377.8%, and EPS to NT$1.93, a year-on-year growth of 370.7%. Additionally, benefiting from the continuous growth of advanced process once-through filter demand, Yixiang's July combined revenue reached NT$3.05 billion, a month-on-month growth of 23.40% and a year-on-year growth of 63.55%, achieving a record high for the third consecutive month.
The 'filter Moore's Law' has taken off, with dual product lines providing a boost to revenue growth.

Yixiang's management team pointed out that leading semiconductor foundry customers have been continuously building new advanced process factories, driving the 'filter Moore's Law' and increasing the precision requirements for air cleanliness and micro-pollution control. As new factories enter the equipment installation and pre-production stages, the demand for high-end once-through filters has remained strong. When the factories have been in operation for a year, customers will gradually introduce recycled chemical filters to achieve their goal of sustainable reduction of carbon emissions and zero waste. Yixiang has a complete layout of once-through and recycled chemical filters, accurately matching the life cycle of semiconductor factories and becoming a key engine for driving revenue and profit growth.
Advanced packaging demand is taking off, and the 'CaaS subscription model' will accelerate in the second half.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Yixiang's management team remains highly optimistic about the company's operating prospects. In addition to the stable pull-in of new advanced process semiconductor factories, the company expects the demand for high-end filters to be driven by the accelerated expansion of advanced packaging capacity by major customers. The company's 'Clean Air as a Service' (CaaS) subscription model will also accelerate in the second half, with high-margin recycled chemical filters expected to contribute significantly to revenue growth. Yixiang, with an absolute market share of over 80% in advanced process filters below 5 nanometers, will maintain its leadership position as the 'purest advanced process clean solution supplier'. As the company's revenue scale continues to expand, it will also demonstrate strong operating leverage and create long-term value for shareholders.

About Yixiang (7909 TT)

Yixiang (7909 TT) was established in 1987 and specializes in the research and development and manufacturing of gas molecular pollution (AMC) filter technology. It is a leading brand in global advanced process micro-pollution control and has a market share of over 80% in high-end filters for advanced semiconductor processes. The company's headquarters is located in New Taipei City, Taiwan, and it has an advanced process filter and recycled filter manufacturing base in Tainan, Taiwan. It has service centers in Taiwan, the United States, mainland China, Europe, and Japan, and has obtained over 100 patents in multiple countries. Yixiang is committed to providing integrated R&D, manufacturing, logistics, and installation 'one-stop AMC solutions' through 'recycled chemical filters' and 'Clean Air as a Service' (CaaS). It aims to become the absolute leader in filters for advanced semiconductor processes below 2 nanometers and lead the new era of green filters for semiconductors.

items.title: 和運租車掛牌上市穩步走蜜月行情 將強化MaaS移動生態系
items.title_en: Andun Car Rental Lists on the Stock Market, Steadily Enters the MaaS Ecosystem
paras: 和泰車 (2207-TW) 旗下全方位移動服務事業和運租車 (7855-TW) 於今 (11) 日正式掛牌上市，承銷價 42 元，早盤以 44 元開出後，最高來到 45 元，穩步展開掛牌蜜月行情，成為和泰集團在資本市場的一個重要板塊。
和運租車董事長劉源森表示，今日成功上市是成立 27 年來的重要里程碑，更是邁向資本市場與永續經營的新起點，未來將持續恪遵高標準的公司治理，維護資訊透明度。
面對移動服務產業的轉型浪潮，劉源森指出，將加速布局 MaaS 移動生態系，並透過 運用 AI 科技運用並導入綠能車隊，持續提升服務品質與營運效率。
和運租車成立於 1999 年，深耕汽車租賃市場 27 年，業務範疇涵蓋法人長租與用車管理、個人長期租車、短期租車和 iRent 共享移動服務，並延伸至中古車流通與汽車保修等後市場服務。
其中，法人長租與用車管理持續維持市場領先地位，提供企業客戶車輛管理、保養、保險和代步等整合服務；而旗下 iRent 共享移動會員數已突破 200 萬人。
為因應消費者和企業多元用車需求，和運整合車輛從投入、使用到退役處置的各階段服務，並串聯 HAA 勁拍中心、HOT 好車與保修大聯盟和 abc 好車網等資源，形成車輛全生命週期的服務模式，除了提供多元移動選擇，也顯著提升車輛於不同階段的運用效益與資源循環利用。
對於綠色移動趨勢，和運表示，正持續擴充電動車及 Hybrid 車隊，並發展智慧充電服務，同時持續將核心的移動能力延伸至公益行動，透過車輛及移動資源支持偏鄉服務、生態保育和弱勢關懷，深化企業永續責任 (ESG)。
和運去年合併營收 297 億元，創歷史新高，每股純益 (EPS)4.61 元，而第一季 EPS 1.3 元，甫公布 7 月合併營收 27 億元，年增 7.02%，營運動能穩健增。
paras_en: Andun Car Rental (7855-TW), a subsidiary of Andun Group (2207-TW), officially listed on the stock market today, with an offering price of NT$42. The stock opened at NT$44 and reached a high of NT$45, steadily entering the honeymoon phase of its listing, becoming an important pillar of Andun Group's presence in the capital market.

Andun Car Rental Chairman Liu Yuansen stated that today's successful listing is an important milestone in the company's 27-year history, marking a new starting point for its journey towards the capital market and sustainable operations. In the future, the company will continue to adhere to high standards of corporate governance and maintain transparency.

In response to the transformation wave in the mobility services industry, Liu Yuansen pointed out that the company will accelerate its layout of the MaaS mobility ecosystem and leverage AI technology to introduce a green energy vehicle fleet, continuously improving service quality and operational efficiency.

Andun Car Rental was established in 1999 and has been deeply involved in the car rental market for 27 years. Its business scope covers corporate long-term rentals and vehicle management, personal long-term rentals, short-term rentals, and iRent shared mobility services, as well as extended services in the after-sales market, including used car circulation and vehicle maintenance.

Among these, corporate long-term rentals and vehicle management have maintained their market-leading position, providing integrated services to corporate clients, including vehicle management, maintenance, insurance, and transportation. Meanwhile, the number of iRent shared mobility members has exceeded 2 million.

To meet the diverse mobility needs of consumers and enterprises, Andun has integrated vehicle services across all stages, from investment to disposal, and connected resources such as HAA centers, HOT car services, and abc car networks, forming a vehicle lifecycle service model. This not only provides multiple mobility options but also significantly enhances vehicle utilization efficiency and resource recycling.

Regarding the trend of green mobility, Andun stated that it is continuously expanding its electric and hybrid vehicle fleets and developing intelligent charging services, while extending its core mobility capabilities to public welfare actions, using vehicles and mobility resources to support rural services, ecological conservation, and social welfare, deepening its commitment to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) responsibilities.

Andun's consolidated revenue last year reached NT$29.7 billion, a new historical high, with an earnings per share (EPS) of NT$4.61. In the first quarter, EPS was NT$1.3, and the company recently announced NT$2.7 billion in consolidated revenue for July, a year-on-year increase of 7.02%, with stable growth in operating performance.
